# MIR interpreter fixtures

`manifest-v0.json` is the machine-readable contract for the first source-to-interpreter slice. Every case must parse, resolve, type-check, complete Flow, lower to MIR, pass the MIR verifier, and then produce the exact return, trap, or bounded-capability outcome plus any declared traces.

The v0 slice accepts an explicitly named zero-argument entry returning `i32` and executes the fixture-backed scalar, tagged, whole-resource, and Region subset. Its 94 cases distinguish exact `integer-overflow`, `division-by-zero`, `signed-division-overflow`, `invalid-shift`, and `assertion-failed` outcomes and prove direct `i32` minimum constants, scalar fixed-array construction, calls and value-copy isolation, contextual immutable and mutable byte-view borrowing, checked reads, aliasing stores, and exact `bounds`, always-checked assertion success/failure, borrowed-view length and emptiness metadata, checked end-exclusive byte slicing across explicit, omitted-start, omitted-end, omitted-both, empty-at-end, reversed, and oversized ranges, non-trapping arithmetic, division, remainder, matching-type bitwise operations, signed arithmetic right shift, unsigned logical right shift, checked matching-type left shift, exact shift-width boundaries, invalid-amount-before-overflow precedence, nearest-loop break/continue targets, and repeated continue execution. Region observations record the lexical span, exit kind, placement count, and number of resource drops completed before reset on fallthrough, direct return, Result propagation, nested, break, and continue exits without exposing addresses or capacity. A case may explicitly bind sorted `fn(i32) -> i32` call symbols to fixture-only stdout/stderr byte hooks and must declare one shared output limit; expected bytes, cross-stream order, and the retained prefix on limit failure are exact. Function spelling alone grants nothing, and no host stream is touched. User drop-body effects, real files, process output, and arguments remain listed deferrals rather than accidental behavior.

`schema-v0.json` uses JSON Schema draft 2020-12 and rejects unknown fields. Source paths are case-root-relative and `/`-separated.
